title: Nursing Science
degree_name: Bachelor of Nursing Science (B.N.Sc) / RN / RM
overview: Nursing professionals are the frontline cornerstone of patient care, assessing patient needs, administering treatment plans, advocating for patient safety, educating families, and managing clinical recovery across acute, community, and emergency settings.
responsibilities: Conduct comprehensive holistic patient assessments and vital signs monitoring
Administer prescribed medications, IV therapies, and wound dressings
Develop and implement individualized Nursing Care Plans (NCP)
Educate patients and caregivers on chronic disease management and post-discharge recovery
Collaborate in multidisciplinary clinical teams (physicians, pharmacists, lab scientists)
Provide compassionate emotional support and end-of-life palliative care
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Basic Medical Sciences / Department of Nursing Science, Ugbowo Campus
olevel_requirements: 5 O'Level Credits in English Language, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, and Physics in not more than TWO sittings (WAEC/NECO/NABTEB).
post_utme_profile: Extremely competitive (Typically requires UTME score of 230+ and strong Post-UTME performance).
clinical_rotations: Extensive clinical postings starting from 300-Level at University of Benin Teaching Hospital (UBTH), covering Medical-Surgical, Paediatrics, Obstetrics/Midwifery, Community Health, Psychiatric Nursing, and Perioperative care.
regulatory_body: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria (NMCN)
career_progression: Nursing Officer II (GL 08 in Civil Service)
Senior Nursing Officer -> Principal Nursing Officer -> Chief Nursing Officer
Academic track: M.Sc Nursing -> Ph.D -> Professor of Nursing
work_environments: Federal Medical Centres & State Specialist Hospitals
International Humanitarian Agencies (MSF, Red Cross, WHO, UNICEF)
Corporate Health Clinics (Oil & Gas, Telecoms, Aviation)
challenges: High patient-to-nurse ratios and heavy physical workload
Emotional strain from severe patient illness and mortality
Rotating shift patterns (night duties, weekend calls, holidays)
Resource constraints in certain public healthcare facilities
international_mobility: Very High (Global shortage of nurses; NMCN qualifications with NCLEX-RN, NMC UK CBT/OSCE, or OET/IELTS open immediate pathways to UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Ireland, and Gulf States).
entrepreneurial_possibilities: Home Health Care & Geriatric Care Agency
First Aid Training & Corporate Ergonomics Consultancy
Medical Scrub & Protective Apparel Design (crossover with tailoring!)

title: Medicine and Surgery
degree_name: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
overview: Medical doctors diagnose illnesses, prescribe and manage comprehensive therapeutic regimens, perform surgical interventions, and oversee the holistic clinical management of human health and disease.
responsibilities: Take medical histories, perform physical examinations, and form differential diagnoses
Order and interpret diagnostic tests (laboratory panels, imaging, biopsies)
Prescribe medications, therapies, and perform invasive clinical procedures/surgeries
Direct resuscitation and intensive emergency care
Counsel patients on prognoses, risks, and treatment options
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Medicine, College of Medical Sciences, Ugbowo Campus
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Bio, Chem, Physics in ONE sitting (preferred/standard in top Nigerian universities).
post_utme_profile: Highest competitive cut-off in UNIBEN (UTME 260-280+ typically required).
clinical_rotations: 400-Level to 600-Level clinical postings at UBTH (Internal Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Paediatrics, Community Medicine, Psychiatry, Ophthalmology, ENT, Anaesthesia).
regulatory_body: Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN)
career_progression: Chief Medical Director (CMD) / Professor of Medicine
work_environments: State Specialist Hospitals & Federal Medical Centres
International Organizations (WHO, UN, Doctors Without Borders)
challenges: Rigorous, lengthy training timeline (6 years MBBS + 1 year Housemanship + 1 year NYSC + 4-6 years Residency)
High responsibility for life-or-death decision making under emergency pressure
Demanding on-call schedules and burnout risks
international_mobility: Very High (Requires professional licensing examinations: PLAB/UKMLA for UK, USMLE for USA, MCCQE for Canada, AMC for Australia).
entrepreneurial_possibilities: Private Hospital or Specialized Diagnostic Clinic

title: Pharmacy
overview: Pharmacists are the leading medication experts in healthcare, responsible for drug discovery, formulation, safety evaluation, therapeutic drug monitoring, patient pharmacotherapy counseling, and preventing adverse drug interactions.
responsibilities: Compound, formulate, and dispense prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceuticals
Perform therapeutic drug monitoring and evaluate drug-drug / drug-nutrient interactions
Counsel patients on correct medication timing, dosages, storage, and side effects
Manage hospital pharmaceutical inventory and cold-chain vaccine storage
Collaborate with physicians to optimize antimicrobial stewardship and chemotherapy regimens
uniben_faculty_dept: Faculty of Pharmacy, Ugbowo Campus (Pioneered Pharm.D in Nigeria)
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Clinical pharmacy rotations at UBTH across inpatient wards, ICU, ambulatory care, oncology pharmacy, and community pharmacy externships.
career_progression: Grade 08/09 Pharmacist -> Senior Pharmacist -> Principal Pharmacist
Chief Pharmacist / Director of Pharmaceutical Services (DPS)
Fellow of West African Postgraduate College of Pharmacists (FPCPharm)
work_environments: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plants (Emzor, Fidson, May & Baker)
Regulatory Agencies (NAFDAC, PCN, Standard Organization of Nigeria)
challenges: Combating counterfeit and substandard medicines in local supply chains
Complex chemistry and pharmacology coursework
High commercial and regulatory compliance responsibilities
international_mobility: High (Requires foreign licensing exams: FPGEE/NAPLEX in USA, GPhC OSPAP in UK, PEBC in Canada).

title: Medical Laboratory Science
overview: Medical Laboratory Scientists are diagnostic detectives who perform complex chemical, biological, haematological, immunological, microscopic, and bacteriological analyses on human fluids and tissues to diagnose diseases.
responsibilities: Analyze blood, urine, tissue, and cerebrospinal fluid samples using automated analyzers and microscopy
Perform cross-matching and blood compatibility testing for emergency blood transfusions
Culture and identify pathogenic bacteria and determine antibiotic susceptibility profiles
Perform molecular diagnostics (PCR, DNA sequencing, antigen testing)
Maintain rigorous laboratory Quality Assurance (QA) and biosafety protocols
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Basic Medical Sciences / Department of Medical Laboratory Science
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Hospital laboratory postings at UBTH across Chemical Pathology, Haematology/Blood Transfusion, Medical Microbiology, and Histopathology.
regulatory_body: Medical Laboratory Science Council of Nigeria (MLSCN)
career_progression: Senior MLS -> Principal MLS -> Chief MLS -> Director of Laboratory Services
work_environments: Public Health Laboratories (NCDC, WHO reference labs)
challenges: Exposure to potentially infectious biohazards requiring strict PPE discipline
Time-sensitive pressure for critical emergency lab values
Equipment calibration and reagent supply chain constraints
international_mobility: Very High (HCPC registration in UK, ASCPi in USA, CSMLS in Canada, AIMS in Australia).
entrepreneurial_possibilities: Specialized Blood Banking & Component Processing Service

title: Physiotherapy / Physical Therapy
degree_name: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (B.PT) / Doctor of Physiotherapy (DPT)
overview: Physiotherapists restore movement and functional ability, alleviate pain, and prevent physical disability in patients recovering from stroke, spinal cord injury, sports trauma, orthopaedic surgery, and congenital neuromuscular disorders.
responsibilities: Assess neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, and cardiopulmonary functional limitations
Design exercise therapy regimens, manual joint mobilizations, and neuromuscular re-education
Utilize electrotherapy, thermotherapy, and hydrotherapy modalities
Rehabilitate stroke patients to regain walking, balance, and independence
Educate patients on workplace ergonomics and postural injury prevention
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Basic Medical Sciences / Department of Physiotherapy
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Clinical postings at UBTH Physiotherapy Department (Orthopaedics, Neurology, Paediatrics, ICU Chest Physiotherapy, Sports Medicine).
regulatory_body: Medical Rehabilitation Therapists Board of Nigeria (MRTB)
career_progression: Senior Physiotherapist -> Principal -> Chief Physiotherapist -> Director of Medical Rehabilitation
work_environments: Sports Teams, Athletic Clubs & National Stadiums
challenges: Physical stamina required for patient transfers and manual mobilization
Long rehabilitation timelines requiring patient motivation and patience
international_mobility: Very High (HCPC in UK, NPTE/FCCPT in USA, CAPR in Canada).
entrepreneurial_possibilities: Home-visit Rehabilitation Service for Stroke Patients

title: Radiography and Radiation Science
overview: Radiographers produce high-quality diagnostic medical images using ionizing radiation, magnetic resonance, and ultrasound, and deliver precision radiotherapy for cancer treatment.
responsibilities: Operate advanced diagnostic equipment: X-ray, CT Scanner, MRI, Fluoroscopy, and Ultrasound
Position patients precisely to visualize anatomical pathologies while ensuring radiation protection (ALARA)
Administer radio-opaque contrast media under protocol
Deliver targeted ionizing radiation in clinical oncology (Radiation Therapy)
Manage Picture Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS)
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Basic Medical Sciences / Department of Radiography
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Clinical rotations at UBTH Department of Radiology & Radiotherapy.
career_progression: Senior Radiographer -> Principal -> Chief Radiographer -> Director of Imaging Services
specializations: Diagnostic Medical Sonography (Ultrasound - Obstetric, Abdominal, Vascular)
work_environments: Equipment Manufacturers (GE Healthcare, Siemens Healthineers, Philips - Application Specialist)
challenges: Strict compliance with radiation safety protocols
High cost of imaging machinery maintenance and downtime
international_mobility: Very High (HCPC in UK, ARRT in USA, CAMRT in Canada).

title: Dentistry and Dental Surgery
overview: Dental surgeons diagnose, prevent, and treat diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial region, teeth, gums, and associated tissues.
responsibilities: Perform oral examinations, caries detection, and dental radiography
Execute restorative fillings, root canal therapy (endodontics), and tooth extractions
Perform surgical tooth impaction extractions and repair facial trauma
Fit prosthetic dentures, crowns, bridges, and orthodontic appliances
Educate communities on oral hygiene and systemic health connections
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Dentistry, College of Medical Sciences, Ugbowo Campus
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics in ONE sitting.
clinical_rotations: Clinical dentistry postings at UBTH Dental Centre (Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery, Conservative Dentistry, Preventive Dentistry, Child Dental Health, Periodontology).
regulatory_body: Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN)
career_progression: Residency -> Consultant Dental Surgeon -> Professor of Dentistry
work_environments: Private Dental Clinics & Oral Health Centres
challenges: Fine manual dexterity and precision required in confined oral space
High cost of dental instruments and clinic setup
international_mobility: High (ORE in UK, NDBEB in Canada, INBDE in USA).
entrepreneurial_possibilities: Private Dental Clinic & Cosmetic Dentistry Studio

title: Public Health
degree_name: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) / Master of Public Health (MPH)
overview: Public health professionals focus on protecting and improving the health of entire populations through disease surveillance, policy development, sanitation, epidemic response, and health promotion.
responsibilities: Design and monitor disease surveillance and epidemic response systems
Analyze epidemiological health data to identify disease outbreaks and trends
Develop public health policies for maternal health, clean water, and vaccination
Manage community health interventions and NGO field projects
Conduct health economics evaluations and programmatic impact assessments
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Basic Medical Sciences / Department of Public Health (or Post-grad in School of Medicine)
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Community field postings in primary health centres, rural epidemiological surveillance sites, and health ministries.
regulatory_body: Public Health Professionals Association / West African Institute of Public Health (WAIPH)
career_progression: Project Director in International NGO / Country Health Director
WHO / UNICEF / Global Fund Technical Advisor
work_environments: National Health Agencies (NCDC, Primary Health Care Development Agency)
challenges: Navigating bureaucratic government systems and funding dependencies
Addressing deeply entrenched social and economic determinants of poverty
international_mobility: Extremely High (Global public health programs readily hire across borders; MPH widely recognized).
entrepreneurial_possibilities: Public Health Consultancy & Program Evaluation Firm
Health Communications & Social Media Advocacy Agency
Health Data Analytics & Survey Research Firm

title: Human Nutrition and Dietetics
degree_name: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) in Nutrition and Dietetics
overview: Clinical dietitians and nutritionists assess nutritional status, design medical nutrition therapies for diseases (diabetes, kidney failure, malnutrition), and optimize food systems.
responsibilities: Conduct clinical nutritional assessments (anthropometric, biochemical, dietary)
Formulate specialized therapeutic diets for hospital inpatients and intensive care (tube feeding/TPN)
Manage community malnutrition intervention programs for infants and pregnant women
Counsel individuals on weight management, hypertension, and diabetes control
Advise institutional food service operations on hygiene and nutrient preservation
uniben_faculty_dept: Faculty of Agriculture / Basic Medical Sciences
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics/Agric in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Dietetics internship and hospital ward postings at UBTH Dietary & Clinical Nutrition Department.
regulatory_body: Dietitians Association of Nigeria (DAN) / Institute of Dietetics in Nigeria (IDN)
career_progression: Senior Dietitian -> Chief Dietitian -> Head of Clinical Nutrition Services
specializations: Clinical Dietetics (Renal, Oncology, Paediatric, Diabetic Nutrition)
work_environments: UN Nutrition Programs (UNICEF, WFP, Action Against Hunger)
challenges: Patient non-compliance with dietary changes due to cultural and economic constraints
Misinformation from unqualified social media 'diet gurus'
international_mobility: High (HCPC UK, CDR USA, Dietitians Canada).
entrepreneurial_possibilities: Private Clinical Nutrition & Weight Loss Consultancy
Specialty Health Food & Therapeutic Snack Production
Corporate Wellness & Employee Meal Planning Services
Baby Food & Weaning Formula Manufacturing using local Nigerian crops

title: Human Anatomy
degree_name: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) in Human Anatomy
overview: Anatomists study the gross, microscopic, and developmental structure of the human body, conducting research in cell biology, embryology, neuroanatomy, and forensic anthropology, while training future healthcare professionals.
responsibilities: Conduct cadaveric dissection and anatomical tissue preparation
Perform histological tissue processing, staining, and light/electron microscopy
Teach gross anatomy, histology, and embryology to medical, nursing, and dental students
Conduct biomedical research on organ preservation, teratology, and neurobiology
Support forensic identification in medico-legal investigations
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Basic Medical Sciences / Department of Anatomy, Ugbowo Campus
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Gross anatomy dissection laboratories, histology and tissue processing units, mortuary and forensic facilities.
career_progression: Graduate Assistant -> Lecturer II -> Senior Lecturer -> Professor of Anatomy
work_environments: Fertility & In-Vitro Fertilization (IVF) Clinics (as Clinical Embryologists)
Forensic Laboratories & Law Enforcement Medical Units
challenges: Limited non-academic hospital positions compared to licensed clinical nursing/medicine
Requires post-graduate studies (M.Sc/Ph.D) or IVF clinical certifications for maximum career earning
international_mobility: High in Academic and IVF Clinical Embryology sectors.
entrepreneurial_possibilities: 3D Anatomical Modeling & Medical Educational Animation Studio

title: Human Physiology
degree_name: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) in Human Physiology
overview: Physiologists investigate the cellular, organ, and systemic mechanisms of the human body, deciphering how electrical, biochemical, and physical functions sustain life and how diseases disrupt homeostasis.
responsibilities: Perform physiological testing: ECG, EEG, EMG, spirometry, and exercise stress tests
Investigate cellular signaling mechanisms and hormonal regulation pathways
Teach human physiology to nursing, pharmacy, and medical students
Conduct cardiovascular, neurophysiological, and metabolic animal/human research
Analyze physiological data for athletic performance and aerospace medicine
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Basic Medical Sciences / Department of Physiology, Ugbowo Campus
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Neurophysiology labs, cardiovascular diagnostic units, respiratory spirometry clinics.
work_environments: Hospital Diagnostic Electrophysiology Suites (ECG, EEG, Sleep Labs)
High-Performance Sports Institutes & Fitness Testing Facilities
challenges: Requires specialized technical certifications for hospital diagnostic unit practice
Primary career path in Nigeria often leans heavily on university lecturing and research
international_mobility: High in Biomedical Research, Neurophysiology Tech, and Clinical Trials.
entrepreneurial_possibilities: Cardiopulmonary Diagnostic Testing & Holter Monitor Service
Sports Performance & VO2 Max Metabolic Testing Centre
Sleep Disorder Screening & Sleep Hygiene Consultancy

title: Medical Biochemistry
degree_name: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) in Medical / Clinical Biochemistry
overview: Medical biochemists explore the molecular machinery of life, enzyme kinetics, metabolic pathways, and genetic mechanisms underlying human diseases, designing targeted therapeutic inhibitors and biomarkers.
responsibilities: Analyze enzymatic assays, protein structures, and lipid biomarkers
Perform molecular assays: ELISA, Western Blotting, Chromatography, and Spectrophotometry
Investigate drug metabolism, liver toxicology, and biochemical pathology
Develop diagnostic test kits for infectious and chronic metabolic diseases
Teach biochemistry principles to undergraduate healthcare cohorts
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Basic Medical Sciences / Faculty of Life Sciences
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Clinical biochemistry hospital laboratories, research biotechnology centres.
regulatory_body: Nigerian Society of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology (NSBMB)
career_progression: Research Scientist -> Senior Biochemist -> Principal Investigator
Quality Control Manager in Pharma/Food Industry
challenges: Abstract molecular concepts requiring strong chemistry aptitude
Equipment-intensive research requiring well-funded laboratories
international_mobility: Very High for Ph.D. scholarships, biotech careers, and pharma research globally.
entrepreneurial_possibilities: Natural Product Extraction & Phytochemical Standardization Firm

title: Health Information Management
degree_name: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc / B.HIM) / HND in Health Information Management
overview: Health Information Managers bridge healthcare, computer science, and administrative management, governing patient health records, electronic medical records (EMR), clinical coding (ICD-10/11), data confidentiality, and hospital analytics.
responsibilities: Manage Electronic Health Record (EHR/EMR) systems and paper medical archives
Perform clinical coding of diseases and surgical procedures using ICD-10/11 for billing and statistics
Ensure patient medical record privacy, data security, and compliance with health data laws (NDPR)
Generate hospital epidemiological and utilization analytics for executive decisions
Train clinical staff (doctors, nurses) on EMR documentation accuracy
uniben_faculty_dept: School of Basic Medical Sciences / Institute of Health Technology, UBTH
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Health Records departments at UBTH, central medical archives, coding and billing units.
regulatory_body: Health Records Officers Registration Board of Nigeria (HRORBN)
career_progression: Health Data Analyst / Clinical Coding Specialist
Health Informatics Manager -> Director of Health Information Systems
work_environments: Health Maintenance Organizations (HMOs) & Health Insurance Agencies
challenges: Managing resistance from clinical staff during electronic record transitions
Safeguarding patient data against cybersecurity breaches
international_mobility: High (AHIMA in USA, CHIMA in Canada, IHRIM in UK - High demand for health informatics).
entrepreneurial_possibilities: EMR Software Consulting & Training for Private Hospitals
Medical Transcription & Remote Clinical Coding Agency
Hospital Record Digitization & Secure Archiving Service
Health Data Analytics Consultancy for HMOs

title: Biomedical Engineering
degree_name: Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng) in Biomedical Engineering
overview: Biomedical Engineers combine engineering principles with biological sciences to design, build, calibrate, and maintain life-saving medical devices, prosthetics, artificial organs, and diagnostic imaging equipment.
responsibilities: Design and develop medical equipment (dialysis machines, patient monitors, ventilators, incubators)
Perform preventative maintenance, safety checks, and calibrations on hospital medical machinery
Develop biocompatible prosthetic limbs, joint implants, and assistive technology
Manage hospital clinical engineering departments and evaluate new medical tech purchases
Collaborate with surgeons and clinicians to optimize biomedical instrumentation in operating theatres
uniben_faculty_dept: Faculty of Engineering / College of Medical Sciences
olevel_requirements: 5 Credits in English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology in max TWO sittings.
clinical_rotations: Clinical engineering attachments at UBTH biomedical workshops, hospital ICU, dialysis and radiology units.
regulatory_body: Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN) / Association of Biomedical Engineers of Nigeria (ABEN)
career_progression: Senior Clinical Engineer -> Chief Biomedical Engineer
Regional Field Service Manager for multinational medical device firms
work_environments: Medical Device Manufacturers (GE, Philips, Mindray, Draeger)
Biomedical Research Institutes & University Engineering Departments
challenges: High mathematical and engineering physics rigor
Scarcity of local spare parts requiring innovative fabrication solutions
international_mobility: Very High (Global demand across healthcare technology and biotech sectors).
entrepreneurial_possibilities: Hospital Medical Equipment Maintenance & Calibration Firm
Medical Device Importation, Sales & Technical Support Company
Solar-Powered Hospital Essential Equipment Manufacturing (Incubators, Phototherapy)
